label: Featured Case
title: Mobile Cinema — Reaching Remote Communities Through Film
challenge: UNICEF needed to reach remote communities across Timor-Leste with critical health and education messages — in areas without TV or internet access.
production: Created animated characters, produced short films, and toured 12 districts with mobile cinema over 8 weeks with a crew of 15.
result: 40,000+ direct viewers. Extended to radio and social media reaching 200,000+ people. Selected for international development film showcase.
